scope: Reusable checklist for assembling a complete SKU Source Passport delivery package for different customers and SKUs.

asset_groups.purpose: Collect brand-owned SKU facts and approved source material.

assets.output: Selected 3-5 SKUs with evidence readiness notes

asset_groups.purpose: Convert SKU facts into evidence-backed claims and buyer questions.

assets.output: Buyer question set for FAQ, variants, and monitor prompts
Manifest of generated source pack artifacts, source hashes, and review state

asset_groups.purpose: Force human approval before publishing or monitoring.
Evaluate AI retrieval answers and convert failures into source revisions.

assets.output: Offline retrieval run input or captured result set

delivery_rules: Use official or customer-approved evidence for every publishable claim.
Omit unknown facts instead of guessing.
Keep price, inventory, discounts, promotions, ratings, reviews, sales volume, and marketplace ranking out of core assets.
Keep social publishing and CMS workflow outside the SKU Source Passport MVP.
Regenerate source hash after approved revisions.
minimum_done_definition: Source input JSON validates against the documented contract.
Canonical source page sections preserve facts, limitations, evidence ids, and citation block.
Source pack manifest lists canonical page, markdown mirror, llms.txt, sitemap, robots, schema, source hash, review status, and revision suggestions.
Buying question bank covers choose, compare, compatibility, and limitation intents where relevant.
Human review checklist has no blocking issues.
Retrieval run template can record provider response, citation quality, wrong specs, limitation preservation, and revision suggestions.
